contract: Named primary journey strings. Machine statuses, IDs and UTC timestamps are invariant. Rule and guidance prose remains in its versioned JSON contracts.

strings.workspaceIntro: Work one gate at a time. Evidence text stays in memory until you export it. Only the last gate ID is saved locally.
strings.draftExported: Draft exported locally. Import it to continue; it is not approved evidence.
strings.answersExported: Answers exported. Run the report-linked resume helper and choose the intended revision if several downloads exist.
strings.bundleImported: Context-bound bundle imported into memory. Review and export before resuming.
strings.unansweredGuidance: Unanswered. Review the guidance before approving.
